name: Screen-Space Gradient Densification Criterion
definition: A criterion for densification based on the mean magnitude of the gradient of the photometric loss w.r.t. the projected 2D screen-space center of the primitive, accumulated over all training views.
summary: Screen-Space Gradient Densification Criterion determines 3D primitive densification using screen-space photometric loss gradients, avoiding gradient cancellation via an analytical T-matrix backward pass.
